Remarks.Remark: Approve Phase 1 wells (1 producer + 1 injector) for Omega Sør Alfa.
Critical: pilot well required to determine Ba content and confirm OWC.
Base case: inject in Tarbert only; Rannoch injection is upside to mature at DG3.
Drainage strategy depends on barium level – decision tree in place.
Template prepared for WAG – evaluate gas injection in next phase.
Pilot well must acquire formation water sample for Ba analysis before WPC.
Core required from pilot to assess deformation bands near ISF.
Remaining uncertainty on RF, permeability and structural understanding at VPBO maturity level.
Gas cap probability negligible (PVT samples confirm). HIPS not required.
Low reservoir permeability in Tarbert – injectivity risk. Mini DST planned.
Customize subsurface deliveries per adapted CVP for subsea tieback (WR3274).
Include production deferral effect from scaling in next economic update.
SSVP presentation 2026-06-15. Concept screening validated post-exploration.
Layout changed from injection CAP-X to 4-slot template at VPbO (2026-03-15). Provides +1 producer slot.

collaboration_project.name: Omega Sør Alfa Field Development
collaboration_project.description: Subsea tieback to Snorre N-template. Phase 1: 1 producer (CAP-X ST from 34/4-19 S) + 1 injector (4-slot template). Tarbert + Rannoch formations, Brent Group.
collaboration_project.purpose: Steward Omega Sør development from SSVP through DG3/DG4 to first oil (Jan 2029). Adapted CVP process for subsea tieback / low pressure / brownfield.

ActivityStates.Remark: STOIIP P90/Mean/P10 = 15.8/19.3/22.9 MSm³. Recoverable 3.3/5.4/8.0 MSm³. RF 16–43%.
NPV 116 MUSD (EQN), IRR 62%, breakeven 25 USD/bbl. Cutoff 2050.
1 producer (CAP-X ST from 34/4-19 S) + 1 injector (4-slot template). Pilot first.
1 injector + 2 producers on Alfa. WAG-ready template, no gas line in Phase 1.
8 risks registered (PIMS PM978). Critical: barium scale (#00061), injectivity.
RMS model in RDDMS maap/omegas. Framework: Top Tarbert, velocity model, fracture zones.
4-slot template south of CAP-X. 8" prod flowline, 6" WI flowline. Tieback to Snorre N.
Pilot from template to deeper structure: OWC, Ba content, Tarbert sand presence, deformation bands.
WPC / DG0 approval pending pilot well outcome.

LastActivityState.Remark: SSVP completed. 8/9 checklist items done. Pilot well scope in progress.

LifecycleEvents.Remark: Unable to sample formation water from 34/4-19 S. Ba content unknown. Decision tree: <50 mg/L proceed; 50-100 evaluate; >100 concept change. Pilot well mandatory.
